decisions.Kwic: 師云：「師資緣契，啐啄同時，子啐母啄，啄與啐不先不後，是為同時。南院上堂示眾云：『諸方只具啐啄同時眼，不具啐啄同時用

Decision.AttributionNote: 玉泉蓮月正禪師語錄, informal address raising Nanyuan's simultaneous pecking-and-hatching case. Lianyue Daozheng is the exact framing speaker of the stored opening definition: he says teacher and disciple meet in accord, chick pecks and mother pecks, neither before nor after, and this is called simultaneous pecking and hatching.
